name: createGNDivision
description: create a new GN Division record

basic.name: createGNDivision
basic.description: create a new GN Division record

args.name: gnDivisionName
args.description: The name for the new GN Division (e.g., 'Dahampura'). This field is required and cannot be empty.

args.name: dsDivision
args.description: The DS Division code or name to assign to this GN Division. Can be either a 6-digit code (e.g., '000005') or a DS Division name (e.g., 'Moratuwa'). Either dsDivision or dsDivisionName must be provided.

args.name: dsDivisionName
args.description: The DS Division name to assign to this GN Division (e.g., 'Moratuwa'). Performs a case-insensitive exact match to find the corresponding code. Either dsDivision or dsDivisionName must be provided.
